name: Mattan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke down its altars and images, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

note.label: 2 Kings 11: The Hidden King and the Covenant to Be the Lord's People

points: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be the Most High's people, and the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, brake its altars and images, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain
